superseded_draft_disclosure: A first draft of this file (22:05Z) proposed a cover-thickness-gated A-only disagreement field as H97-1. It was withdrawn before any H97 fit, holdout read or canary run, because grepping the repository showed that experiment is already recorded and closed: H62 'buried structural corridors' ran cover-gated, edge-conditioned, persistence-filtered A-only disagreement and returned NEGATIVE (knowledge/33, registry/h62_buriedcorr_preregistration.json). Re-running it would be re-litigating a closed experiment (AGENTS.md). The draft was never executed and no number in this session derives from it.
lane: the brief's single method paragraph: co-training between View A (potential-field: gravity, magnetics, strain, seismicity) and View B (surface: DEM curvature and slope, plus any radiometric band present in training_features.tif), disagreement as the discovery signal
primary_arm: h97_disagree (View A confident, View B abstains: A_rank * (1 - B_rank))

view_definitions_frozen.A: bands 18, 11, 5 (isostatic gravity horizontal/vertical gradient, slope), 3, 9 (TMI horizontal/vertical gradient), 2 (RTP); each channel = percentile-rank of the Gaussian gradient magnitude at sigma 2 px, equal weights
view_definitions_frozen.B: band 12 detrended elevation curvature magnitude at sigma 2 and 6 px, band 12 gradient magnitude at sigma 2, band 19 detrended-slope curvature at sigma 2, band 6 in-stack radiometric total count smoothed at sigma 4; equal weights
view_definitions_frozen.band6_justification: IR-H85-005 resolved band 6 as the GeoDAWN total count by bytes despite its magnetic tag; re-measured this round in evidence/h97_holdout.json (band6_recheck) instead of quoted

experiment_1.instrument: hide-and-recover, gems52.spatial.folds label-blind quadrants v2, buffer 80 px, whole components hidden, 200 m collar from the VISIBLE catalogue only
experiment_1.scoring: gems52.evaluate_holdout.evaluate + pooled_summary (gems52-pooled-hide-v1, alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, R 300 m, 1000 paired 20 km block-bootstrap draws)
experiment_1.independence: spatial.negative_block_errors (50x50 px blocks) + spatial.independence, on catalogue-zero proxies inside each fold's TRAIN domain only; abandonment threshold 0.60
experiment_1.canary: per-arm AUC against the held-out truth inside the allowed set; alarm 0.90

experiment_2.instrument: gems52-offcatalogue-prevalence-matched-v1: SGMC fault pixels >= 300 m from labels.tif, thinned with a fixed seed (88052) to 14089 px so the prevalence matches the incumbent |G| bracket instead of quadrupling it the way the H83 instrument did (knowledge/76 §6)
experiment_2.placement: spacing_select 3 px on the full footprint, 200 m catalogue ring removed
experiment_2.control: matched random over the same allowed set at every K
experiment_2.reference: data/reference/h33-2-b2-zeros.tif scored as-is for context; it is a prior submission used for learning only, never re-emitted

budget_rule_frozen.rule: K* = the K with the highest instrument-2 DTI iff that K is < 37654 AND its DTI exceeds the DTI at K = 37654 by at least 0.001 AND exceeds the matched random control at that K; otherwise K* = 37654 and the mass lever is reported as unmeasured for this field
budget_rule_frozen.why: the lever is only credible if the prevalence-matched instrument, not the over-rewarding one, says the credit stops arriving before the budget stops

emission_frozen.values: binary {0,1}, zeros outside the organiser domain, no nodata tag
emission_frozen.container_reason: the all-finite container is the one the current 0.2778 champion file itself uses (knowledge/76 §1) and the only one that cannot fail a literal [0,1] range test

promotion_rule: paired 95% CI lower bound of (h97_disagree - random) > 0 on gems52-pooled-hide-v1 AND K* measured below the full budget; otherwise the round is negative and the file is download-only
expected_board_claim: none; the arithmetic targets (S <= 25384 at champion T, or T >= 6007 at champion S) are arithmetic, not forecasts
inputs_provenance: integrity-pinned, not organizer-authenticated; scripts/restore_data.py reported ALL_VERIFIED=True for 23/23 pins in this session
